meta.name: seo-image-gen
meta.description: AI image generation for SEO assets: OG/social preview images, blog hero images, schema images, product photography, infographics. Powered by Gemini via nanobanana-mcp. Requires banana extension installed. Use when user says "generate image", "OG image", "social preview", "hero image", "blog image", "product photo", "infographic", "seo image", "create visual", "image-gen", "favicon", "schema image", "pinterest pin", "generate visual", "banner", or "thumbnail".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为SEO内容自动生成配图与社交预览图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为网站或博客生成SEO优化的图片素材
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate SEO-optimized images for content and social previews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need SEO-friendly images for your website or blog

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成用于 SEO 的图片，比如社交媒体预览图、博客头图、产品照片和信息图。生成后还会给出 alt 文本、文件命名和 WebP 转换等优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“生成图片”、“OG 图片”、“博客头图”、“产品照片”等关键词，或使用 /seo image-gen 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张博客头图，主题是人工智能的未来。
生成一张产品照片，白色背景，展示新款智能手表。
为这篇文章生成一张 OG 预览图，尺寸 1200x630。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate SEO-optimized images like OG/social previews, blog hero images, product photos, and infographics based on your description. It also provides post-generation SEO tips such as alt text, file naming, and WebP conversion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "generate image", "OG image", "blog hero", "product photo", etc., or use the /seo image-gen command.

say_en.text: Generate a blog hero image about the future of AI.
say_en.note: Claude creates a 16:9 widescreen hero and gives SEO tips.

say_en.text: Create a product photo with white background for a smartwatch.
say_en.note: Claude generates a 4:3 product shot and suggests alt text.

say_en.text: Make an OG preview image for this article, 1200x630.
say_en.note: Claude produces a social preview and provides og:image markup.
